description: Take control of your life by changing the way you operate your life #careeradvice #lifebydesign #fyppppppppppppppppppppppp
transcript: I've learned to make decisions and follow through with them. If we don't make decisions and hold ourselves accountable to fall in alignment with them, we allow the external world to make decisions for us. We allow the external world to tell us to move left when we're supposed to be moving right. The more that we take action to follow through, the more control that we take over our lives. My life began to change when the way in which I operated changed. My life changed when I stopped sweeping things under the rug. When I started addressing things for what they are, I stopped being passive and the less passive I became, the easier it is to be proactive. I completely removed myself away from being reactive in situations because they are small. I can address them as they come.
